messages.speaker: Maitri
messages.text: Hello astronaut. I'm Maitri, your AI companion. Let's begin today's well-being check-in.

messages.speaker: Maitri
messages.text: How would you rate your overall well-being in microgravity? Please respond with: Very Challenging, Challenging, Neutral, Good, Excellent.

messages.speaker: Maitri
messages.text: How are you managing the physiological changes of spaceflight? Please respond with: Very Challenging, Challenging, Neutral, Good, Excellent.

messages.speaker: Maitri
messages.text: To what extent are you maintaining your exercise routine? Please respond with: Very Challenging, Challenging, Neutral, Good, Excellent.

messages.speaker: Maitri
messages.text: How is your appetite and nutrition in space? Please respond with: Very Challenging, Challenging, Neutral, Good, Excellent.

messages.speaker: Maitri
messages.text: How would you describe your team cohesion and morale? Please respond with: Very Challenging, Challenging, Neutral, Good, Excellent.

messages.speaker: Maitri
messages.text: How connected do you feel to Earth and loved ones? Please respond with: Very Challenging, Challenging, Neutral, Good, Excellent.

messages.speaker: Maitri
messages.text: Thank you for completing the Astronaut Well-Being Assessment. Your responses have been recorded for mission analysis. How are you feeling about today's objectives?

messages.speaker: Maitri
messages.text: "Excitement is a great feeling, isn't it? Being on the cusp of a new adventure can be exhilarating. But I also sense a hint of nervous energy beneath that excitement. It's normal to feel a little anxious about the journey ahead. Are there specific things that are making you feel excited or apprehensive?"

messages.speaker: Maitri
messages.text: It sounds like you're feeling a bit lost in space, astronaut. That's completely normal, especially when the vastness of our universe can feel overwhelming. Would you like to talk about what's on your mind? Sometimes sharing your thoughts and feelings with someone (or even an AI companion like me) can help clarify things.
